newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen injecting reserves into banking system.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen injecting reserves into banking system.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to add reserves to the banking system on Wednesday, either through fixed multiple-day or overnight repurchase agreements, economists said.

The Fed refrained from entering the system on Tuesday, but its add need was seen rising. It also was possible the Fed would permanently inject reserves into the system via an outright purchase of securities, economists said.
Fed funds were trading right at the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/2 percent.
